scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build:local: npx cross-env VITE_BUILD_MODE=local npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:android: npx cross-env VITE_BUILD_MODE=local npm --prefix frontend run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'android/app/src/main/python/static/*'; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force 'frontend/dist/*' 'android/app/src/main/python/static/'"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev" "npx --prefix desktop electron desktop/main.js"
